title: Road to a bigger neck: 18 inches or bust!
summary: His 16-inch neck grew from deadlifts and rows but has stopped growing despite strength gains, which he takes as evidence against 'just deadlift' or 'just genetics'. He sets an 18-inch goal and starts direct neck isolation with plates as an experiment.

claims.claim: His neck is 16 inches and he has never trained it directly.
His neck used to be small and grew on its own from deadlifts, rows and other pulls.
He disagrees that neck size is purely genetic or that deadlifts are enough: his neck has stopped growing even though his deadlift keeps getting stronger.
For a neck to look good from the front, it should be wider than the jaw; with his big head and wide jaw, his neck looks too narrow.
His neck goal is 18 inches, which he thinks will extend it past his jawline.
Plan: keep deadlifting and rowing but add neck isolation work, neck extensions with plates.
Experiment: if his neck grows from 16 to 18 inches without bodyweight gain, the growth came from the isolation work.
A big neck improves a physique tremendously.

exercises.name: Plate neck extensions
exercises.why: direct isolation to grow a neck that stopped responding to compounds

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.why: grew his neck early on but stopped working for it
